why: Rejects `?dev=1&identityMarker=solid` to null at the parse (issue #922). Null is the ruled arm, so the reversal value would select the shipped `shape` marker it exists to undo, and the developer pane would report it as a rejected value. The registry would still list `solid`, so nothing in the flag's own documentation would show the break. Killed by the vocabulary case, the parse case for the reversal value, and the page-HUD case that loads `?dev=1&identityMarker=solid`.
killedBy: the identity-marker flag vocabulary (issue #922) accepts every flag value and rejects anything else -- population: 4 values, 7 rejects
parseDevFlags: identityMarker (issues #630, #922 -- the kept identity-marker lever) accepts the reversal value, so the pre-ruling ring is reachable and not reported rejected
parseDevFlags: identityMarker (issues #630, #922 -- the kept identity-marker lever) does not disturb the other flags
createBrowserDeps carries the parsed browser query state into GameDeps hands the page HUD the shipped FFA identity mark, and none for the reversal value (issue #922)
